title: Tour Guide booking record (data contract v1, WP-10a)
description: One thing to book for a trip: its rule, when booking opens and when to book by (both with an explicit offset), and its status. tour-guide-checks.mjs also checks: real dates and date-times, opens_at ≤ book_by. Kept in a trip's bookings[] and sent in the bookings envelope (the same record is repeated inline there and in tour-guide-trip.schema.json: the validator subset has no cross-file $ref).

rule.description: The booking rule in one line, e.g. "opens 30 days ahead at 10:00".

place.description: The place slug it is for, when there is one.

for_date.description: The trip-local day it is for.

opens_at.description: When booking opens, with the destination's explicit offset.

book_by.description: Book before this (≥ opens_at), with an explicit offset.

datetime.description: ISO 8601 date-time with an explicit offset (Z or ±HH:MM), e.g. 2027-03-01T10:00:00+13:00; no fractions.
